title: When RAG Fails to Equalize: Geo-bias in Factual Question Answering over Public Companies
abstract: arXiv:2608.25717v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely assumed to mitigate factual errors in large language models (LLMs), but it remains unclear whether retrieval uniformly compensates for missing knowledge. We study this question in a controlled factual QA setting over public companies, constructing a benchmark of approximately 2,000 firms across global equity indices. We evaluate six LLMs on four atomic attributes under four conditions: no-context, perfect context, misleading context, and distraction context. We find strong geographic disparities in no-context accuracy, indicating uneven parametric knowledge. While perfect context improves performance, it does not eliminate these gaps: gains are correlated with baseline accuracy, suggesting retrieval effectiveness is coupled to internal representations. translated_title: 当检索增强生成未能实现均衡：上市公司事实问答中的地理偏差
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25717v1 公告类型：新 摘要：检索增强生成（RAG）被广泛认为能缓解大型语言模型（LLMs）中的事实错误，但检索是否均匀地补偿缺失的知识仍不清楚。我们在一个受控的上市公司事实问答环境中研究此问题，构建了一个涵盖全球股票指数中约2000家公司的基准数据集。我们在四种条件下评估了六个LLM在四个原子属性上的表现：无上下文、完美上下文、误导性上下文和干扰性上下文。我们发现无上下文准确性存在显著的地理差异，表明参数化知识不均匀。虽然完美上下文能提升性能，但并未消除这些差距：增益与基线准确性相关，表明检索效果与内部表征相关联。在误导性上下文下，模型经常复制错误信息。更大的模型提高了整体性能，但并未消除这些偏差。
tldr: 本研究揭示了检索增强生成在上市公司事实问答中无法消除地理偏差，因为检索增益与模型内部知识的不均衡性相关，且误导性上下文会加剧错误复制。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that retrieval-augmented generation fails to eliminate geographic bias in factual QA over public companies, as retrieval gains correlate with uneven internal knowledge and misleading contexts exacerbate error copying.
